result.summary: This diff replaces the JXA-drawn screenshot with a native rasterizer that reuses Ghostty's sprite and font code plus CoreText shaping. It adds a pinned, checksummed download of the JetBrains Mono font, an !ss alias and tab-bar glyphs, broader refusal of shell messages over the web bridge, and clearer guest spawn errors. I checked the build changes, the new dependencies, the download and verification path, the osascript invocation, config and file reads, and the web bridge change, and found nothing deceptive or harmful.

findings.title: Pinned font download for screenshots
findings.detail: Screenshots now fetch Ghostty's default font (JetBrains Mono 2.304) from raw.githubusercontent.com on first use and cache it. Each file is pinned by SHA-256, capped at 1 MiB and checked for a TrueType header. The bytes are only loaded as font data through CoreText (CTFontManagerCreateFontDescriptorFromData) and never executed. This serves the screenshot feature and the README mentions it.

findings.title: osascript use narrowed
findings.detail: copyToClipboard no longer forwards the environment or an output path to osascript. The JXA script now only reads the PNG and puts it on the pasteboard. The rendering moved into native Zig (raster.zig, raster_coretext.zig), which is pure pixel and CoreText work with no I/O beyond font lookup.

findings.title: Reads Ghostty's config locally
findings.detail: loadGhosttyConfig reads ~/.config/ghostty/config and the macOS Application Support Ghostty config. It parses only font, cursor and faint-opacity keys so screenshots match Ghostty's rendering. The data stays in-process.

findings.title: Web bridge shell refusal broadened
findings.detail: allowedOverWeb now refuses every client message whose tag begins with shell_, including future ones. This replaces an explicit list of five shell messages, so it tightens the web bridge's restrictions. The new doc comment was inserted between runTailscale's existing doc comment and its function, which is cosmetic only.

findings.title: New hash-pinned build dependencies
findings.detail: The new z2d and jetbrains_mono dependencies come from deps.files.ghostty.org, the same mirror Ghostty itself uses, and are pinned by Zig package hashes. jetbrains_mono is lazy and used only by tests. The Ghostty font sources are copied unmodified from the already-pinned ghostty dependency, alongside small local stand-in files. No build-time code execution was added beyond file copying and module wiring.

data_flows.what: HTTP GET for the two JetBrains Mono variable font files on first screenshot. Only the request itself is sent, and the downloads are checked against SHA-256 digests pinned in the binary.
data_flows.to: raw.githubusercontent.com (JetBrains/JetBrainsMono v2.304), via asset_store, cached locally

data_flows.what: PNG screenshot of the rendered terminal frame. The temp file is deleted after osascript runs.
data_flows.to: $TMPDIR/marlin-shot-<random>.png, then /usr/bin/osascript (fixed JXA script) and the macOS general pasteboard

data_flows.what: PNG screenshot, written instead of being copied to the clipboard when the user sets this variable.
